newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Telefonica boosted by alliance.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Telefonica boosted by alliance.

text.p: Telefonica de Espana's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) rose Friday, boosted by news of its alliance with MCI Communications Corp and British Telecommunications Plc.
Traders said ADRs in general were being helped by the expiration of options on individual stocks and indexes, and by a steadier long bond.
"The market seems to be finding its level, and people are just picking and finding stocks," said Val Kosmider, head of international equity trading at Schroder Wertheim.
